consulted.section: Triage, run isolation, and sandbox constraints
consulted.evidence: Artifact-first triage identified the v00 program error, v01-v07 outcomes, and keyframes without running episodes locally; the clean-task-slate constraints were followed throughout.

consulted.section: Standard Localization Helper, Prompt Registry, Disambiguation, Key Signals, Prompting Strategy, Placement Z Notes
consulted.evidence: The literal fallback prompts grey bowl, metal bowl, bowl and black cabinet, drawer cabinet, cabinet consistently localized both objects on seed 51 and supplied runtime point clouds for all geometry.

Following the downward top-down template reached and closed on the bowl in v01, v05, and v07, but keyframes showed the bowl remained on the tabletop during lift and task_success stayed false on seed 51; this cost three measured attempts.
The picked object was a shallow bowl rather than a bottle or can, so the cylindrical side-grasp recipe was not applied.

The programs used close_gripper rather than set_gripper, checked typed motion results, and treated close success as insufficient; v05 and v07 keyframe review confirmed the need for retention verification.
Quantiles over the public bowl and cabinet point clouds produced stable runtime-derived grasp height, bowl clearance, cabinet surface, and placement coordinates on seed 51.
The staged lift, transit, carry, place sequence completed all motion calls in v05 and v07 without program errors; it was not the limiting failure because the bowl was never retained.

consulted.section: Pre-Probe IK Conditioning and Safe Transit
consulted.evidence: No retained-object transit was available to evaluate these sections independently; the measured failures occurred before a verified carry.
The target was a cabinet top plane rather than a basket or container interior.

consulted.section: Knob / Switch Turning, Hinged Door Opening / Closing, Pushing / Sliding, General Notes
consulted.evidence: Task 4 is a bowl pick-and-place with no knob, hinged door, or push interaction.
